changelog:
BobLimt v1.0.16

- Fixed a 27k bug where unticking with both UL and DL active could desync your character (random movement / dropped inputs); the resync trigger now passes through correctly.
- Raid/dungeon clear banner now appears within seconds of finishing instead of being delayed: the tracker briefly fast-polls right after an activity ends, then returns to its normal idle cadence (no extra background load).
- No changes to gameplay logic, keybinds, swaps, or the update process.
